#Region "Main"
    SET Status TO $'''Active'''
    SWITCH %Status%
        CASE 'Active'
            Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''User is active'''
        CASE 'Inactive'
            Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''User is inactive'''
        DEFAULT
            Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Unknown status'''
    END
    SWITCH %ErrorCode%
        CASE '0'
            SET Result TO $'''OK'''
        CASE '404'
            SET Result TO $'''Not Found'''
        CASE '500'
            SET Result TO $'''Server Error'''
        DEFAULT
            SET Result TO $'''Unknown'''
    END
#EndRegion
